run_ConfigTester_common_tests: run all common config tests for a transformers model configuration class
test_ConfigTester_json_serialization: test that a transformers config can serialize to and deserialize from a JSON file
test_ConfigTester_pretrained_save_load: test saving and loading a transformers config using save_pretrained and from_pretrained
test_ConfigTester_composite_subconfig: test that composite config sub-configs load and save correctly with from_pretrained
test_ConfigTester_custom_kwargs: test passing custom kwargs to from_pretrained to overwrite specific config values
